newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm aid to focus more on environment - Steichen.
newsitem.headline: EU farm aid to focus more on environment - Steichen.

text.p: European Union farm subsidies will increasingly be targeted towards encouraging farmers to use environmentally-friendly production methods, former EU Farm Commissioner Rene Steichen said on Thursday.
"The switch from production related payments to more specific environmental payments will continue," Steichen told Reuters after a symposium of farmers and environmentalists.
The three-day gathering was organised by the Agricultural Reform Group, an informal alliance of British farmers and environmentalists, to discuss the future role of farmers.
Steichen, who chaired the symposium, said there was a real interest among farmers from other countries, especially in Scandinavia and Austria, for protecting the countryside.
Farmers were no longer exclusively food producers but also had other important roles in providing rural services and managing natural resources.
